summary: Pre-registered iteration-2 DEV comparisons C1-C6 on tier a (well-specified sim_targets) and tier c (sky130c misspecified targets) at NGSpice budgets 500, 2000 and 5000 per target: 36 tests, Holm at alpha 0.05 on the geometry-level Wilcoxon p.

data_state_at_writing.note: These four tier-a directories were read and analyzed in iteration 1 (out/research/report/2026-10-16_dev_iteration1, out/research/dev/stats_iter1). No directory of lam_curve_k8, dfols_style, the seed 1/2 replicates or any tier-c (out/research/dev_sky130c) run existed when this file was written and committed. C1 and C2 on tier a therefore include seed-0 data already analyzed in iteration 1; their seed 1/2 replicates (C1) and all tier-c data are new.

comparisons.question: surrogate term in the sketched trust region vs the same code without it
surrogate term in the full-Jacobian trust region vs the same code without it
per-curve surrogate weight (n2b) vs the sketched trust region without surrogate
per-curve surrogate weight (n2b) vs the fixed full surrogate term
named DFO-LS-style baseline vs the sketched trust region without surrogate
per-curve surrogate weight (n2b) vs the named DFO-LS-style baseline

difference: A - B per target; negative = A has the lower endpoint value

a.definition: paper RRMS of the final card with frozen published-baseline curve inclusion (one fresh NGSpice score); a target whose included curve fails enters at its penalized value (failed curves at RRMS 10) and is counted

c.definition: strict RRMS as tier a minus the target's floor (floors.json 'floor', finalized = min(polish, reference)); unclipped

per_target_value: mean over the arm's seeds at that budget: seed 0 = the base label, seed n = the registry label '<arm>__seed<n>'
test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test (scipy.stats.wilcoxon, zero_method 'wilcox') on the 18 geometry-mean differences (each geometry: mean of its set_0 and set_1 differences)

multiplicity.family: all 36 tests; a test that cannot be computed enters with p = 1

effect_size: mean difference over the 36 targets with the geometry-clustered bootstrap 95% CI: 10,000 resamples (numpy default_rng seed 0) of the 18 geometries with replacement, a drawn geometry contributes both of its sets, an arm's seeds within a target are resampled when it has 2 or more; percentile interval
decision_rule: a test is reported as a difference at the family level when its Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05; the direction is the sign of the mean difference; the clustered CI is the reported interval
secondary: log10 RRMS on tier a (mean over seeds of log10(max(RRMS, 1e-6))), same statistics, outside the Holm family
i.i.d. bootstrap 95% CI over the 36 targets (dev_compare.paired), reported next to the clustered CI
win/tie/loss with dev_compare's tie rule (tie when |diff| < max(1e-6, 1% of the larger value))
leave-one-geometry-out maximum |change of the mean difference|
Dolan-More performance profiles per budget over the arms of C1-C6 (values floored at 1e-6)
More-Wild data profiles from the B5000 traces, tau in {0.1, 0.01, 0.001}, f_0 = bank-oracle RRMS
